fullPassage: Heritability is frequently misunderstood. For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and environmental influences. A simpler way of expressing this is that it describes what is but does not predict what could be. Another population, or the same population at a different time, could have a different mix of genetic and environmental influences. Heritability will reflect these differences. For example, heritability of body weight is greater in wealthier countries such as the US than in poorer countries such as Albania and Nicaragua. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic differences in people's propensities to put on the pounds.

det.tip: pay ... pounds=~파운드를 지불하다(화폐). put on the pounds=살이 찌다(체중). 같은 단어, 다른 의미

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a piece of information shown as a number that describes a particular situation"

det.korean: 특정 상황을 숫자로 나타낸 정보 조각
det.analysis:
❌ ① decision(결정): 선택이지 숫자로 된 정보가 아님
❌ ② promise(약속): 무관
❌ ③ opinion(의견): 주관적 견해일 뿐
✅ ④ statistic(통계치): 특정 상황을 숫자로 보여주는 정보=통계치 ← 정답
det.tip: statistic=통계치. 본문 'It is a statistic that describes a particular population'

questions.passage: For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and __________ (environment) influences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: environment → environmental: 명사 influences를 꾸미는 형용사 자리
det.analysis: environment(명사, 환경) → environmental(형용사, 환경의). 'genetic and ______ influences'에서 and로 형용사 genetic과 병렬 연결되어 명사 influences를 수식하므로 형용사형이 필요. 명사 environment에 -al을 붙여 형용사 environmental
det.tip: environment(명사) → environmental(형용사). genetic(형용사)과 and로 병렬되는 형용사 자리

questions.passage: For example, heritability of body weight is greater in wealthier countries such as the US than in poorer countries such as Albania and Nicaragua. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic __________ (differ) in people's propensities to put on the pounds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: differ → differences: 형용사 genetic의 수식을 받는 복수명사 자리
det.analysis: differ(동사, 다르다) → differences(명사, 차이). 'exposes genetic ______'에서 타동사 exposes의 목적어이자 형용사 genetic의 수식을 받는 명사 자리. 동사 differ를 명사 difference로 바꾸고, 여러 유전적 차이를 뜻하므로 복수형 -s를 붙임
det.tip: differ(동사) → difference(명사) → differences(복수). 타동사의 목적어는 명사

questions.passage: Heritability is frequently misunderstood. For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and environmental influences. A simpler way of expressing this is that it describes what is but does not predict what could be. Another population, or the same population at a different time, could have a different mix of genetic and environmental influences. Heritability will reflect these differences. For example, heritability of body weight is greater in wealthier countries such as the US than in poorer countries such as Albania and Nicaragua. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic differences in people's propensities to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람들의 ______ 성향에서의 유전적 차이를 드러낸다

❌ ② save some money(돈을 모으다): 체중 맥락과 무관
❌ ③ lose their memory(기억을 잃다): 무관
❌ ④ learn a new language(새 언어를 배우다): 무관
det.tip: put on the pounds=살이 찌다. body weight, fattening food와 연결되는 체중 관련 표현

questions.passage: Heritability is frequently misunderstood. For example, it is not a constant like the speed of light or gravity. It is a statistic that describes a particular population at a particular time with that population's particular mix of genetic and environmental influences. A simpler way of expressing this is that it describes what is but does not predict __________. Another population, or the same population at a different time, could have a different mix of genetic and environmental influences. Heritability will reflect these differences. Wealthier countries have greater access to fast-food outlets and high-energy snacks, and greater access to fattening food leads to higher heritability because it exposes genetic differences in people's propensities to put on the pounds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 현재가 어떤지는 기술하지만 ______은 예측하지 않는다
det.analysis:
❌ ① who they are(그들이 누구인지): 사람의 정체는 문맥과 무관
✅ ② what could be(무엇이 될 수 있는지): 'describes what is(현재)'와 짝을 이루어 '예측하지 않는 미래의 가능성' ← 정답
❌ ③ where it ends(어디서 끝나는지): 무관
❌ ④ why it matters(왜 중요한지): 무관
det.tip: what is(현재의 모습) ↔ what could be(가능한 모습). 기술(describe)과 예측(predict)의 대조
